data.why: The repository already bundles the stored UNAIDS 2026/WDI snapshot (data/processed/*.csv, data/processed/hiv_surveillance.db, reports/results.json and reports/analysis_tables/*.csv) that the dashboard reads directly; no pipeline run or synthetic data is needed.

goals: Compare HIV trend indicators (AIDS deaths, new infections, PLHIV, prevalence, ART coverage, mortality-in-PLHIV) across Southeast Asian countries and years
Inspect Myanmar's 2010-2025 trajectory for AIDS deaths, ART coverage and PLHIV as a headline case
Review the treatment cascade (diagnosed / on ART / virally suppressed, against both all-PLHIV and conditional denominators) for 2025
Estimate the approximate unreached PLHIV treatment gap by country
Compare clustered panel-model specifications (country FE, country+year FE, lagged ART, GDP-adjusted, leave-one-country-out, threshold-substitution sensitivity) for the ART-mortality association
Relate national GDP per capita to ART coverage in 2025 and run fixed read-only SQL examples against the SQLite snapshot

review.summary: This tree matches the README and app.py closely: every tab, control, export and fixed SQL example is covered, with general wording that carries over to other tools and specific wording true to this one, and every screen I checked shows what the node says. Only small wording and completeness changes remain, and none blocks filing.
